name: Energy Infrastructure Trust
summary: Energy Infrastructure Trust, an infrastructure investment trust, engages in the transportation of natural gas through pipeline in India. The company owns and operates a natural gas pipeline with a length of approximately 1,485 kilometers across India, as well as compressor stations and pipeline operation centers. It offers parking and lending services. The company serves oil refineries, fertilizer, petrochemical, power, city gas distribution, and other industrial sectors. The company was formerly known as India Infrastructure Trust and changed its name to Energy Infrastructure Trust in January 2025.
